overview: Italy is a very attractive destination for students who are interested in engineering, technology, innovation and scientific research. It has universities offering undergraduate programs in mechanical engineering, civil engineering, electrical engineering, electronics, computer science, automation, aerospace and other technical fields.

Undergraduate Engineering in Italy is usually a three-year bachelor's degree (called Laurea in Italian), although some integrated or specialized courses follow a different structure. Students develop technical knowledge through lectures, laboratory sessions, engineering projects and, depending on the program, internships or research activities.

Indian students who have completed Class 12 can find studying Undergraduate Engineering in Italy to be a gateway to gain exposure to European higher education and to explore specialized engineering fields. Students should however check carefully the language of instruction, entrance examination, academic eligibility and international admission rules at each university.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help students to shortlist the right universities, understand the entry requirements, prepare the application documents and plan the steps to apply to institutions in Italy.

sections.title: Why Study Undergraduate Engineering in Italy?

items: Italy has a long tradition in engineering, manufacturing, architecture, automotive technology, and industrial design. Its universities have programs that connect scientific fundamentals and engineering applications
Key reasons to consider Undergraduate Engineering in Italy include:
Wide range of engineering disciplines: Students can explore mechanical, civil, electrical, electronics, computer, aerospace, chemical and industrial engineering.
Practical learning: Depending on the course, students may complete laboratory work, technical assignments, design projects and team-based activities.
International academic exposure: Some institutions offer English-taught undergraduate engineering programmes or selected international tracks.
Technology and industry connections: Italy has industries related to automotive engineering, machinery, manufacturing, energy, automation and advanced materials.
Opportunities for further study: Graduates can explore relevant master's programmes after meeting the entry requirements.
Scholarship opportunities: Eligible students may investigate university scholarships, regional financial support and tuition reductions.
Students planning to Study Undergraduate Engineering in Italy should compare programmes according to their career interests, teaching language, curriculum, tuition fees and admission requirements.

The engineering courses in Italian universities are different. A regular bachelor's engineering degree is three years long, consists of 180 ECTS credits. Students should check the structure of each program.
Mechanical Engineering

Mechanical engineering is the field concerned with machines, manufacturing systems, mechanics, thermodynamics, materials, and product design. It could be of interest to students studying automotive engineering, industrial machinery, robotics, or production systems.
Civil Engineering

Civil engineering encompasses structural engineering, building materials, infrastructure, transportation systems, geotechnical engineering, and water resources. This is excellent for students interested in infrastructure and construction projects.
Electrical Engineering
Electrical engineering is concerned with electrical circuits, power systems, electrical machines, energy technologies and control systems.
Electronics Engineering
Electrical engineering deals with electrical circuits, power systems, electrical machines, energy technologies and control systems.
Computer Engineering

Computer engineering is the engineering that involves combining computing and hardware, digital systems, networks and software. The structure of the courses is not the same as that of computer science degrees.
Aerospace Engineering
Aerospace engineering includes aerodynamics, flight mechanics, propulsion, aerospace structures and related technologies. Institutions offer a range of availability and entry options.
Chemical Engineering
Chemical engineering is concerned with chemical processes, industrial production, process design, materials and energy systems.
Automation and Robotics Engineering
Such programs may include control systems, robotics, sensors, industrial automation and smart manufacturing.
Industrial Engineering
Industrial engineering deals with industrial systems, quality management, optimization, logistics, production planning and manufacturing.

Take Italy for example. If you want to compare undergraduate engineering courses, students will have to look at the official syllabus to see the balance between maths, physics, laboratory work and specialized subjects.

sections.title: Eligibility for Undergraduate Engineering in Italy

items: Students applying from India must meet the university's academic and international admission requirements.
Academic Qualifications
Applicants generally need:
Recognized secondary school qualification (Grade 12 or equivalent).
The number of years of schooling required by the relevant regulations of Italian universities.
Mathematics and physics preparation if required by the program.
An academic record acceptable to the selection criteria of the university.
Any further assessment of qualifications needed for international applicants.

According to the regulations and the presented qualification, some universities require a proof of total schooling for 12 or 13 years. If the applicant does not have the required level of education, they may apply through a recognized foundation course or other accepted pathway.
Subject Requirements
Mathematics is of particular importance to most engineering programs. Physics and other science subjects may also be required or assessed for admission.
Language Requirements
Applicants must meet the language requirement of their chosen programme.
English-taught programmes: An accepted English language qualification or other acceptable evidence may be required.
Italian-taught programmes: Normally requires a good command of Italian, often at B2 level if stated.
Additional language obligations: Some universities require students in English-taught programs to demonstrate Italian proficiency before completing their degrees.
Entrance Examinations

Universities might require an entrance test, selection based on ranking or any other evaluation. Politecnico di Milano has entrance exams for Engineering 2026/27 with accepted alternatives according to the official rules.
Students planning to Study Undergraduate Engineering in Italy should confirm all requirements directly with the university before paying application or examination fees.

sections.title: Admission Requirements for Undergraduate Engineering in Italy

items: The admission process may include academic verification, an entrance test, language assessment and document checks.
Common requirements include:
Marksheets/transcripts of Class 10 and Class 12
Certificate of Matriculation.
Valid passport.
Entrance test score (if applicable)
Proof in English or Italian where necessary.
Official translations of academic documents, if required.
Documentation to prove the validity and equivalence of foreign qualifications.
Application form. Payment of any applicable fee.
Other forms or declarations required by the university.
Entrance Test Preparation
Depending on the institution, an engineering entrance test may assess:
Mathematics
Physics or scientific reasoning
Logic and problem-solving
Basic quantitative skills
Other topics specified in the official test syllabus
The test format, accepted alternatives, registration deadlines and scoring rules differ between universities.
Can Indian Students Apply After Class 12?

Yes, Indian students are eligible to apply provided their school qualifications meet the relevant admission rules and they fulfill the academic, language and entrance-test requirements of the program. The university will evaluate the eligibility and just passing Class 12 does not guaranty admission.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help applicants to go through program specific requirements and prepare their application documents.

sections.title: Recognition, Professional Registration and Further Study

items: An undergraduate engineering degree can provide a foundation for employment or further study, but professional requirements depend on the intended role and country.
Further education: Graduates might want to look at postgraduate programs in their engineering discipline, subject to the entry requirements of the next program.
Industry employment: Employers may evaluate technical knowledge, project experience, software skills, and communication skills.

Regulated professional activities: Certain engineering positions or professional titles may require additional recognition, registration or professional examinations, depending on the country and type of work.
Employment in India: graduates should check the requirements of the specific employer, role and any relevant professional body.
Employment in Italy: Knowledge of Italian may be important for internships, workplace communication and many engineering roles.
Students should confirm that their selected qualification and study plan align with their long-term career objectives.

sections.title: Career Opportunities After Undergraduate Engineering in Italy

items: Engineering graduates may explore opportunities across manufacturing, construction, automotive, electronics, energy, technology, automation and other technical sectors.
Possible entry-level career pathways include:
Junior Mechanical Engineer
Graduate Civil Engineer
Electrical Engineering Trainee
Electronics Engineer
Junior Software or Computer Engineering Role
Production or Manufacturing Engineer
Quality Assurance Engineer
Automation and Robotics Trainee
CAD or Design Engineer
Technical Project Assistant
Energy Systems Assistant
Research or Laboratory Assistant
The roles available to a graduate depend on the degree specialisation, technical skills, work experience, language proficiency and local employment requirements.
Skills That Can Improve Career Prospects
Students can strengthen their professional profile by developing:
Mathematics and analytical problem-solving
Computer-aided design and simulation skills, where relevant
Programming and computational skills
Laboratory and technical project experience
Communication and teamwork
Knowledge of engineering safety and quality standards
Italian language proficiency for relevant local opportunities
Some graduates enter employment after their bachelor's degree, while others continue to a master's degree to gain advanced technical knowledge or specialise in a particular field.

If you are considering Study Undergraduate Engineering in Italy , then you should consider the curriculum and the career routes supported by the degree and not the general salary promises or guarantyd job outcomes.

faq.question: Can Indian students study undergraduate engineering in Italy after Class 12?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students can apply if they meet the academic eligibility, schooling requirements, language conditions and entrance-test criteria of the university. Admission is not automatic and depends on the chosen program.

faq.question: Are undergraduate engineering courses in Italy taught in English?
faq.answer: Some undergraduate engineering programs or tracks are taught in English, but many are taught in Italian. Students should check the language of instruction for each degree before applying.

faq.question: What are the fees for undergraduate engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: As a rough guide for planning purposes, tuition at public universities may cost between about €900 and €4,000 per year, while private institutions may charge more. Actual fees for engineering programs vary by institution and by fee-assessment rules.

faq.question: Is an entrance exam required for engineering admission in Italy?
faq.answer: Many engineering programs have entrance tests or selection procedures. For example, Politecnico di Milano lists specific admission tests and acceptable alternatives for its 2026/27 engineering bachelor's programs. Requirements vary from university to university.

faq.question: Can I work in Italy after completing an undergraduate engineering degree?
faq.answer: Graduates may explore employment opportunities, subject to their qualifications, skills, language proficiency and applicable work authorisation rules. Some students choose to continue with a master's degree before entering specialised engineering roles.
